spec.name: degradation-off-codex
spec.intent: Re-prove forge's degrade-and-warn laws without codex. census @ 8753f969 (local://what-ships-census.md): 62 codex lines across these 5 files use codex as the only witness. The laws: bound on one harness and steer on one that falls short (degradation.test.ts); the unrealizable and unscopable losses (realization.test.ts); a closure declared plus one warning when a harness has no preload field (skill-closure.test.ts); per-harness projection facts that differ (projection-facts.test.ts); and the warden fixture comment. Use claude or omp wherever a supported harness exhibits the path. An event claude or omp does not realize gives steer via 'unrealizable'. Where no supported harness exhibits the path (realizes ∧ ¬scopes; preloadsSkills=false), use one test-local adapter in packages/forge/test/project/shortfall-adapter.ts. Add no new *.test.ts file, because gate-convicts lists every test file. Do not touch the codex adapter itself.
accept: `git grep -n -i codex -- packages/forge/test/project` prints nothing. At 8753f969 it prints 62 lines.

Each of these laws keeps at least one assertion, and the return lists each by test name: bound vs steer for one vector; an 'unrealizable' loss; an 'unscopable' loss; a closure degraded to a declaration plus exactly one warning; differing projection facts per harness.
`pnpm --filter @cratylus/forge exec vitest run test/project` is green, and `pnpm exec biome check` passes on the outputs.
